class NonceReuseError(Exception):
    """Raised when an AES-GCM nonce is reused."""
    pass


class AESGCMNonceGuard:
    """Guards against nonce reuse in AES-GCM encryption."""

    def __init__(self, nonce_length: int = 12):
        self.nonce_length = nonce_length
        self._seen_nonces = set()

    def generate_nonce(self) -> bytes:
        """Generates a cryptographically secure random nonce."""
        return os.urandom(self.nonce_length)

    def register_nonce(self, nonce: bytes) -> None:
        """Registers an externally provided or generated nonce.

        Raises NonceReuseError if the nonce has already been registered.
        """
        if nonce in self._seen_nonces:
            raise NonceReuseError(f"Nonce reuse detected: {nonce!r}")
